ownership_decision.invariant: A Batch Reflection is written once, names at least one development case and its batch version, and owns its suggestions alone.

boundary_decision.interaction: No new collaboration: the reviewed batch-eval-batch-trials interaction already supplies the batch facts; this records the aggregate the schema already enforces.

domain_forces: The schema already enforces the round's invariants; the Registry did not name them.
implementation_design.decision: Record the Batch Reflection aggregate with citations of the constraints and the store function that writes it; no code changes.
invariants_preserved: The rules and the interaction reviewed in batch-reflection-recited-2026-11-07 are unchanged.
rejected_alternatives: Citing the constraints from the existing rules, which state behaviour rather than the aggregate boundary.
implementation_design.counterfactual_check: db/tests/immutability_test.sql already turns red for an UPDATE-only trigger and for a two-column foreign key; the two integration tests turn red when owns() ignores the round.

invariants: A round is stored once in batch_reflections and never updated or deleted outside an account purge; its outcome, its development test cases and its counts of runs read and not read are decided before it is written.
A round names at least one development test case and records the skill version of its batch, which the composite foreign key to evaluation_batches keeps equal to the batch version.
Every suggestion in evaluation_suggestions has exactly one owner, an evaluation or a round, so a round suggestion never appears under a run.
